scope: Entire76shot exported rough cut. Still-board observations identify failures only; they cannot certify motion, listening or full visual acceptance.

rubric.sceneChange: 0 absent;1 nominal/slideshow;2 noticeable but weak narrative change;3 meaningful with a specific repair;4 verified entry/action/result/exit at normal speed
rubric.lyricMeaning: 0 contradicts/absent;1 label replaces action;2 partial;3 mostly communicates with repair;4 verified visible meaning across complete phrase
rubric.physicalContinuity: 0 broken;1 major scale/contact/world mismatch;2 partial;3 works with repair;4 verified continuous physical relationship
rubric.aggregation: No score from unobserved criteria. Missing remains null. Minimum verified dimension governs; user rejection0 overrides.

repairCandidate.finding: Current event5212 genuinely scores0, but an observed beat exists one frame before the cut. Prior no-beat interpretation was too broad: an8frame reaction margin excluded it. Test a contact/response carried across the cut instead of moving the action outside its lyric.
